title: QR utility routes: /scan redirect and /qr static QR page with noindex

requirements.summary: Add public /scan route that immediately client-redirects to the portfolio URL and shows a brief English redirecting message.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/scan` triggers a client-side redirect to `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/` without requiring any user interaction.
While redirecting, the page renders an English message such as "Redirecting to portfolio…" so users are not staring at a blank screen.
The redirect does not create an infinite loop and does not redirect back to `/scan`.

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight public page that, on mount, performs a client-side redirect to `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/` (e.g., using a replace-style navigation) and renders an English message like "Redirecting to portfolio…" during the brief transition.
Wire the new `/scan` route into the existing TanStack router under the public layout so it is publicly accessible.

requirements.summary: Add public /qr route that displays a static QR image encoding the portfolio URL plus English instructions and readable URL text, responsive for mobile/desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/qr` shows a QR code image that, when scanned by a phone camera, opens `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/`.
The QR page includes clear English instructions and displays the destination URL as readable text.
The QR code image is served as a static asset from `frontend/public/assets/generated/` (not generated dynamically via backend calls).
The `/qr` page is responsive and looks acceptable on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static QR image asset (black-and-white) that encodes `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/` at `frontend/public/assets/generated/qr-portfolio.dim_512x512.png`.

Create a public page that displays the static QR image from `frontend/public/assets/generated/qr-portfolio.dim_512x512.png`, includes short English instruction text (e.g., "Scan to open my portfolio"), and shows the destination URL as readable text with responsive layout suitable for mobile and desktop.
Wire the new `/qr` route into the existing TanStack router under the public layout so it is publicly accessible.

requirements.summary: Ensure /scan and /qr are marked noindex,nofollow using the existing route-aware SEO head manager behavior without affecting existing public/admin SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: When visiting `/scan` and `/qr`, the page includes `meta[name="robots"]` set to `noindex, nofollow`.
Public SEO behavior for existing portfolio pages remains unchanged.
Admin route SEO behavior remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Extend the existing route-aware SEO logic to treat `/scan` and `/qr` as utility routes and set `meta[name="robots"]` to `noindex, nofollow` for those paths, while keeping existing public route SEO handling and the current admin route behavior unchanged.

Add explicit SEO entries for `/scan` and `/qr` (titles/descriptions appropriate for utility pages) so the SEO manager can resolve these routes deterministically without impacting existing public route mappings.
